pass_rule: positive after costs in BOTH halves of the span
baseline: entries at random minutes, same exits, same number of trades, seeded, mean of 200 runs; trades drawn from 3000 random entries (overlap and the day guards are not modelled, so it is a luck yardstick, not a second bot)
limits: one-minute bars, not ticks: what happened inside a minute is unknown (stop first when a bar touches both)
practice fills: the next bar's open worsened by 1 basis point, no queue, no partial fills, no market impact
only the last 180 days: one stretch of market, no bear or crash year unless it happened in it
the grid was fixed before looking and is small: no tuning, no multiple-testing correction
SPY has no dividends (split-adjusted bars); stock results ignore short-term tax
the halves are the first and second 90 days
